key.name: download-dir
key.description: Empty means the system Downloads folder.

key.name: restrict-filenames
key.description: Sanitize download filenames to ASCII-only characters, also avoiding ampersands and spaces.

key.name: enable-scheduled-downloads
key.description: When off, the scheduler never runs and the schedule option is hidden from the New Download card.

key.name: auto-add-downloads
key.description: Skip confirmation: single videos start right after lookup with the preferred quality, and links opened from other apps start without asking, except links to this computer or a private network, which always ask.

key.name: max-concurrent
key.description: How many downloads may run at once.

key.name: connections
key.description: How many parallel range connections a large download may use. 1 disables segmented downloading.

key.name: speed-limit
key.description: Download speed limit (e.g. 500K, 2M). Empty means unlimited.

key.name: proxy-mode
key.description: System honors the desktop proxy settings; manual uses the proxy below; direct disables proxying. Applies to newly started downloads; torrents always go direct.

key.name: proxy-type
key.description: One of http, https or socks5. SOCKS5 resolves names remotely.

key.name: proxy-host
key.description: Proxy hostname or address, e.g. 127.0.0.1 for a local Tor forwarder.

key.name: proxy-port
key.description: Proxy port, e.g. 9050 for Tor.

key.name: keep-server-date
key.description: Set each finished file's modification time from the server's Last-Modified header when present.

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Send a desktop notification when a download finishes or fails.

key.name: notify-background
key.description: Send a desktop notification when closing the window while downloads keep running in the background.

key.name: inhibit-suspend
key.description: Block system suspend while downloads are queued or running.

key.name: torrent-seed-finished
key.description: Keep uploading finished magnet downloads instead of pausing them.

key.name: torrent-dht
key.description: Find torrent peers through the distributed hash table. Applies when the torrent engine first starts.

key.name: torrent-upload-limit
key.description: Torrent upload speed limit (e.g. 500K, 2M). Empty means unlimited.

key.name: torrent-seed-ratio
key.description: Stop seeding after uploading this multiple of the download size. 0 means unlimited.

key.name: torrent-seed-time
key.description: Stop seeding this many minutes after finishing. 0 means unlimited.

key.name: torrent-blocklist-url
key.description: URL of a peer blocklist (eMule ipfilter.dat format) applied to every torrent. Empty means disabled. Applies when the torrent engine first starts.

key.name: torrent-lsd
key.summary: Find torrent peers on the local network
key.description: Discover torrent peers on the local network via Local Service Discovery. Applies when the torrent engine first starts.

key.name: torrent-listen-port
key.description: Port for incoming torrent connections (enables seeding). 0 disables listening. Applies when the torrent engine first starts.

key.name: torrent-upnp
key.description: Ask the router to forward the torrent listen port via UPnP. Only applies when a listen port is set. Applies when the torrent engine first starts.

key.name: video-quality
key.description: Target height for video-page downloads: best, 2160p, 1440p, 1080p, 720p, or 480p.

key.name: video-codec-priority
key.description: Newest first prefers AV1, then VP9, HEVC and H.264; most compatible prefers H.264 first for players without newer decoders.

key.name: subtitle-language
key.description: Download subtitles in this language with new video downloads when the video offers it, else English when offered. 'off' disables subtitle downloads.

key.name: embed-subs
key.description: Mux downloaded subtitle tracks into the finished video file instead of keeping sidecars only.

key.name: cookies-browser
key.description: Read cookies straight from this browser's profile for age-gated or member-only video pages. 'none' disables it.

key.name: last-auto-paste
key.summary: Last URL inserted by clipboard auto-paste
key.description: Prevents a stale clipboard link from pasting again on every fresh open, across restarts.

key.name: browser-extension-ids
key.summary: Browser extension IDs for native messaging
key.description: Comma-separated Chromium extension IDs (from chrome://extensions) allowed to use the Grab native messaging host. Stored once via --install-browser-host; manifests are re-installed automatically on startup.

key.name: sponsorblock-remove
key.description: Cut SponsorBlock-flagged sponsor segments out of new video downloads.

key.name: sponsorblock-mark
key.description: Mark SponsorBlock-flagged sponsor segments as chapters in new video downloads.

key.name: remux-video
key.description: Remux finished video downloads into another container without re-encoding. 'off' disables remuxing.

key.name: embed-chapters
key.description: Write chapter markers into the finished file on new downloads.

key.name: live-from-start
key.description: Record live streams from the beginning when the site supports it.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Last used window width.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last used window height.
